Eq 29\n            axys = (\n                εyy1 * εyy2 / εzz2 / ns21\n                - εyy4 * εyy3 / εzz3 / ns34\n                + n * (εyy2 * εyy4 - εyy1 * εyy3) / ns21 / ns34\n            ) / (e + w)\n\n            # Eq 28 transformed\n            ayxe = (\n                εxx1 * εxx4 / εzz4 / ew14\n                - εxx2 * εxx3 / εzz3 / ew23\n                + w * (εxx2 * εxx4 - εxx1 * εxx3) / ew23 / ew14\n            ) / (n + s)\n\n            # Eq 29 transformed\n            ayxw = (\n                εxx3 * εxx2 / εzz2 / ew23\n                - εxx4 * εxx1 / εzz1 / ew14\n                + e * (εxx4 * εxx2 - εxx1 * εxx3) / ew23 / ew14\n            ) / (n + s)\n\n            # Eq 30\n            axye = (εyy4 * (1 + εyy3 / εzz4) - εyy3 * (1 + εyy4 / εzz4)) / ns34 / (\n                e + w\n            ) - (\n                2 * εyx1 * εyy2 / εzz1 * n * w / ns21\n                + 2 * εyx2 * εyy1 / εzz2 * s * w / ns21\n                + 2 * εyx4 * εyy3 / εzz4 * n * e / ns34\n                + 2 * εyx3 * εyy4 / εzz3 * s * e / ns34\n                + 2 * εyy1 * εyy2 * (1.0 / εzz1 - 1.0 / εzz2) * w^2 / ns21\n            ) / e / (\n                e + w\n            ) ^ 2\n\n            # Eq 31\n            axyw = (εyy2 * (1 + εyy1 / εzz2) - εyy1 * (1 + εyy2 / εzz2)) / ns21 / (\n                e + w\n            ) - (\n                2 * εyx1 * εyy2 / εzz1 * n * e / ns21\n                + 2 * εyx2 * εyy1 / εzz2 * s * e / ns21\n                + 2 * εyx4 * εyy3 / εzz4 * n * w / ns34\n                + 2 * εyx3 * εyy4 / εzz3 * s * w / ns34\n                + 2 * εyy3 * εyy4 * (1.0 / εzz3 - 1.0 / εzz4) * e^2 / ns34\n            ) / w / (\n                e + w\n            ) ^ 2\n\n            # Init Fields\n    Ex = zeros(ComplexF64, (size(Hx,1)-1, size(Hx,2)-1))\n    Ey = zeros(ComplexF64, (size(Hy,1)-1, size(Hy,2)-1))\n    Ez = zeros(ComplexF64, (size(Hz,1)-1, size(Hz,2)-1))\n    diffx = x[2:end] .- x[1:end-1]\n    diffy = y[2:end] .- y[1:end-1]\n\n    # using Maxwell's curl equation.\n\n    Hz = (1/(j*beta)) * (dHx/dy - dHy/dx)\n    \"\"\"\n    ny, nx = Hx.shape\n    Hz = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n\n    diffx = np.diff(x)\n    diffy = np.diff(y)\n\n    for j in range(ny - 1):\n        for i in range(nx - 1):\n            dx = diffx[i] if i < len(diffx) else diffx[-1] if len(diffx) > 0 else 1.0\n            dy = diffy[j] if j < len(diffy) else diffy[-1] if len(diffy) > 0 else 1.0\n            dHxd_y = (Hx[j + 1, i + 1] + Hx[j + 1, i] - Hx[j, i + 1] - Hx[j, i]) / (2.0 * dy)\n            dHyd_x = (Hy[j + 1, i + 1] + Hy[j + 1, i] - Hy[j, i + 1] - Hy[j, i]) / (2.0 * dx)\n            Hz[j, i] = (dHxd_y - dHyd_x) / (1j * beta + 1e-15)\n\n    return Hz\n\n\ndef _reconstruct_e(\n    Hx: np.ndarray,\n    Hy: np.ndarray,\n    Hz: np.ndarray,\n    x: np.ndarray,\n    y: np.ndarray,\n    beta: complex,\n    omega: float,\n    epsilon: EpsilonCallback,\n) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:\n    \"\"\"Reconstruct electric field components Ex, Ey, Ez from H fields.\n\n    Uses:\n        D = (1/(j*omega)) * curl H\n        E = inv(eps) * D\n    \"\"\"\n    ny, nx = Hx.shape\n    diffx = np.diff(x)\n    diffy = np.diff(y)\n\n    Ex = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n    Ey = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n    Ez = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n\n    for j in range(ny - 1):\n        for i in range(nx - 1):\n            dx = diffx[i] if i < len(diffx) else diffx[-1] if len(diffx) > 0 else 1.0\n            dy = diffy[j] if j < len(diffy) else diffy[-1] if len(diffy) > 0 else 1.0\n            xc = (x[j] + x[j + 1]) / 2.0 if j < len(x) - 1 else x[j]\n            yc = (y[i] + y[i + 1]) / 2.0 if i < len(y) - 1 else y[i]\n\n            eps_xx, eps_xy, Hz.shape[0] and i < Hz.shape[1] else 0.0\n\n            # D components (with beta correction for propagation)\n            Dx = dHz_dy / (1j * omega + 1e-15) + beta / omega * (Hy[j + 1, i + 1] + Hy[j + 1, i] + Hy[j, i + 1] + Hy[j, i]) / 4.0\n            Dy = -dHz_dx / (1j * omega + 1e-15) - beta / omega * (Hx[j + 1, i + 1] + Hx[j + 1, i] + Hx[j, i + 1] + Hx[j, i]) / 4.0\n\n            Ex[j, i] = (eps_yy * Dx - eps_yx * Dy) / det_eps\n            Ey[j, i] = (-eps_xy * Dx + eps_xx * Dy) / det_eps\n            Ez[j, i] = 0.0  # Simplified: would need dHy/dx - dHx/dy\n\n    return Ex, Ey, Ez\n\n\ndef solve_modes(\n    config: ModeSolverConfig,\n    epsilon: EpsilonCallback,\n    x: tuple[float, ...],\n    y: tuple[float, ...],\n) -> tuple[ModeSolution, ...]:\n    \"\"\"Solve for np.sum(np.abs(Ex) ** 2) + np.sum(np.abs(Ey) ** 2) + np.sum(np.abs(Ez) ** 2)\n        )\n        if power > 0:\n            power_norm = 1.0 / math.sqrt(power)\n        else:\n            power_norm = 1.0\n\n        def _to_tuple_complex(arr: np.ndarray) -> tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]:\n            flat = arr.flatten()\n            return tuple((float(v.real), float(v.imag)) for v in flat)\n\n        # Convert Hx back to same shape as Ex (ny-1, nx-1) via simple average\n        Hx_c = (Hx[:-1, :-1] + Hx[1:, :-1] + Hx[:-1, 1:] + Hx[1:, 1:]) / 4.0\n        Hy_c = (Hy[:-1, :-1] + Hy[1:, :-1] + Hy[:-1, 1:] + Hy[1:, 1:]) / 4.0\n        Hz_c = Hz\n\n        modes.append(\n            ModeSolution(\n                neff=neff,\n                wavelength=config.wavelength,\n                x=x,\n                y=y,\n                Ex=_to_tuple_complex(Ex * power_norm),\n                Ey=_to_tuple_complex(Ey * power_norm),\n                Ez=_to_tuple_complex(Ez * power_norm),\n power_norm**2,\n            )\n        )\n\n    return tuple(modes)\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"EpsilonCallback\",\n    \"assemble_mode_matrix\",\n \"\"\"\n    if bc.condition == \"dirichlet\":\n        return 0\n    if bc.condition == \"neumann\":\n        return 1\n    if bc.condition == \"bloch\":\n        return 2\n    raise ValueError(f\"unknown boundary condition: {bc.condition}\")\n\n\ndef assemble_mode_matrix(\n    x: tuple[float, ...],\n    y: tuple[float, ...],\n    wavelength: float,\n    epsilon: EpsilonCallback,\n    boundaries: tuple[BoundaryCondition, BoundaryCondition, BoundaryCondition, BoundaryCondition],\n) -> \"sparse.csc_matrix | sparse.csr_matrix\":\n    \"\"\"Assemble the sparse (2*nx*ny, 2*nx*ny) for the generalized\n        eigenvalue problem A · φ = β² · φ.\n    \"\"\"\n    if sparse is None:\n        raise ModuleNotFoundError(\"scipy is required for the mode solver\")\n\n bc_south = _map_boundary_condition(boundaries[1])\n    bc_east = _map_boundary_condition(boundaries[2])\n    bc_west = _map_boundary_condition(boundaries[3])\n\n    # Number of unknowns\n    N = nx * formulation)\n            ns21 = n_ * eps_yy2 + s_ * eps_yy1\n            ns34 = n_ * eps_yy3 + s_ * eps_yy4\n            ew14 = e_ * eps_xx1 + w_ * eps_xx4\n            ew23 = e_ * eps_xx2 + w_ *  A.eliminate_zeros()\n    return A\n\n\ndef _reconstruct_hz(\n    Hx: np.ndarray, Hy: np.ndarray, x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, beta: complex\n) -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"Reconstruct Hz from Hx and Hy using Maxwell's curl equation.\n\n    Hz = (1/(j*beta)) * (dHx/dy - dHy/dx)\n    \"\"\"\n    ny, nx = Hx.shape\n    Hz = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n\n    diffx = np.diff(x)\n    diffy = np.diff(y)\n\n    for j in range(ny - 1):\n        for i in range(nx - 1):\n            dx = diffx[i] if i < len(diffx) else diffx[-1] if len(diffx) > 0 else 1.0\n            dy = diffy[j] if j < len(diffy) else diffy[-1] if len(diffy) > 0 else 1.0\n            dHxd_y = (Hx[j + 1, i + 1] + Hx[j + 1, i] - Hx[j, i + 1] - Hx[j, i]) / (2.0 * dy)\n            dHyd_x = (Hy[j + 1, i + 1] + Hy[j + 1, i] - Hy[j, i + 1] - Hy[j, i]) / (2.0 * dx)\n            Hz[j, i] = (dHxd_y - dHyd_x) / (1j * beta + 1e-15)\n\n    return Hz\n\n\ndef _reconstruct_e(\n    Hx: np.ndarray,\n    Hy: np.ndarray,\n    Hz: np.ndarray,\n    x: np.ndarray,\n    y: np.ndarray,\n    beta: complex,\n    omega: float,\n    epsilon: EpsilonCallback,\n) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:\n    \"\"\"Reconstruct electric field components Ex, Ey, Ez from H fields.\n\n    Uses:\n        D = (1/(j*omega)) * curl H\n        E = inv(eps) * D\n    \"\"\"\n    ny, nx = Hx.shape\n    diffx = np.diff(x)\n    diffy = np.diff(y)\n\n    Ex = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n    Ey = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n    Ez = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n\n    for j in range(ny - 1):\n        for i in range(nx - 1):\n            dx = diffx[i] if i < len(diffx) else diffx[-1] if len(diffx) > 0 else 1.0\n            dy = diffy[j] if j < len(diffy) else diffy[-1] if len(diffy) > 0 else 1.0\n            xc = (x[j] + x[j + 1]) / 2.0 if j < len(x) - 1 else x[j]\n            yc = (y[i] + y[i + 1]) / 2.0 if i < len(y) - 1 else y[i]\n\n            eps_xx, eps_xy, eps_yx, eps_yy, eps_zz = epsilon(xc, yc)\n            det_eps = eps_xx * eps_yy - eps_xy * eps_yx + 1e-15\n\n            # dHz/dy\n            dHz_dy = (Hz[j, i] + Hz[j + 1, i] - Hz[j, i + 1] - Hz[j + 1, i + 1]) / (2.0 * dy) if j < Hz.shape[0] and i < Hz.shape[1] else 0.0\n            # dHz/dx\n            dHz_dx = (Hz[j + 1, i + 1] + Hz[j + 1, i] - Hz[j, i + 1] - Hz[j, i]) / (2.0 * dx) if j < Hz.shape[0] and i < Hz.shape[1] else 0.0\n\n            # D components (with beta correction for propagation)\n            Dx = dHz_dy / (1j * omega + 1e-15) + beta / omega * (Hy[j + 1, i + 1] + Hy[j + 1, i] + Hy[j, i + 1] + Hy[j, i]) / 4.0\n            Dy = -dHz_dx / (1j * omega + 1e-15) - beta / omega * (Hx[j + 1, i + 1] + Hx[j + 1, i] + Hx[j, i + 1] + Hx[j, i]) / 4.0\n\n            Ex[j, i] = np.array(x)\n    yc = 0.5 * (y[:-1] + y[1:]) if len(y) > 1 else np.array(y)\n\n    # Pad cell centers too\n    xc = np.concatenate([[x[0] - diffx[0] / 2], xc, [x[-1] + diffx[-1] / 2]])\n    yc = np.concatenate([[y[0] - diffy[0] / 2], yc, [y[-1] + diffy[-1] / 2]])\n\n    # Map boundary codes\n    bc_north = _map_boundary_condition(boundaries[0])\n    bc_south = _map_boundary_condition(boundaries[1])\n    bc_east = _map_boundary_condition(boundaries[2])\n    bc_west = _map_boundary_condition(boundaries[3])\n\n    # Number of unknowns\n    N = nx * ny\n\n    # Allocate coordinate-format triplets\n    rows: list[int] = []\n    cols: list[int] = []\n    data: list[float] = []\n\n    def _add(ii: int, jj: int, val: float) -> None:\n        if abs(val) > 1e-15:\n            rows.append(ii)\n            cols.append(jj)\n            data.append(val)\n\n    for i in range(nx):\n        for j in range(ny):\n            # Physical cell dimensions\n            n_ = diffy[j + 1]\n            s_ = diffy[j]\n            e_ = diffx[i + 1]\n            w_ = diffx[i]\n\n            # Get epsilon tensor at four corners of this cell\n            eps_xx1, eps_xy1, eps_yx1, eps_yy1, eps_zz1 = epsilon(xc[i], yc[j + 1])\n            eps_xx2, eps_xy2, eps_yx2, eps_yy2, eps_zz2 = epsilon(xc[i], yc[j])\n            eps_xx3, eps_xy3, eps_yx3, eps_yy3, eps_zz3 = epsilon(xc[i + 1], yc[j])\n            eps_xx4, eps_xy4, eps_yx4, eps_yy4, eps_zz4 = epsilon(xc[i + 1], yc[j + 1])\n\n            # Weighted averages (following VectorModesolver.jl formulation)\n            ns21 = n_ * eps_yy2 + s_ * eps_yy1\n            ns34 = n_ * eps_yy3 + s_ * eps_yy4\n            ew14 = e_ * eps_xx1 + w_ * eps_xx4\n            ew23 = e_ * eps_xx2 + w_ * eps_xx3\n\n            # Avoid division by zero\n            def _safe_div(a: float, b: float) -> float:\n                return a / b if abs(b) > 1e-15 else 0.0\n\n            # Diagonal and neighbor coefficients for Hx (first N equations)\n            # Axx central\n            axxp = (\n                -(\n                    _safe_div(2.0, e_ * (e_ + w_))\n                    + _safe_div(eps_yy4 * eps_yx3 / eps_zz3 - eps_yy3 * eps_yx4 / eps_zz4, (e_ + w_) * ns34)\n                    + _safe_div(eps_yy2 * eps_yx1 / eps_zz1 - eps_yy1 * eps_yx2 / eps_zz2, (e_ + w_) * ns21)\n                )\n     - (\n                    _safe_div(2.0, s_ * (n_ + s_))\n                    + _safe_div(eps_xx2 * eps_xy3 / eps_zz3 - eps_xx3 * eps_xy2 / eps_zz2, (n_ + s_) * ew23)\n                )\n (e_ + w_) * ns21)\n                - _safe_div(eps_yy2 * eps_yy1 / eps_zz2, (e_ + w_) * ns21)\n                + k**2 * (n_ + s_) * (eps_yy4 * eps_yy3 * e_ / ns34 + eps_yy1 * eps_yy2 * w_ / ns21) /     )\n                - (\n                    _safe_div(eps_xx2 * (1.0 + eps_xx3 / eps_zz2) - eps_xx3 * (1.0 + eps_xx2 / eps_zz2), ew23 * (n_ + s_))\n                    - (\n _reconstruct_hz(\n    Hx: np.ndarray, Hy: np.ndarray, x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, beta: complex\n) -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"Reconstruct Hz from Hx and Hy using Maxwell's curl equation.\n\n    Hz = (1/(j*beta)) * (dHx/dy - dHy/dx)\n    \"\"\"\n    ny, nx = Hx.shape\n    Hz = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n\n    diffx = np.diff(x)\n    diffy = np.diff(y)\n\n    for j in range(ny - 1):\n        for i in range(nx - 1):\n            dx = diffx[i] if i < len(diffx) else diffx[-1] if len(diffx) > 0 else 1.0\n            dy = diffy[j] if j < len(diffy) else diffy[-1] if len(diffy) > 0 else 1.0\n            dHxd_y = (Hx[j + 1, i + 1] + Hx[j + 1, i] - Hx[j, i + 1] - Hx[j, i]) / (2.0 * dy)\n            dHyd_x = (Hy[j + 1, i + 1] + Hy[j + 1, i] - Hy[j, i + 1] - Hy[j, i]) / (2.0 * dx)\n            Hz[j, i] = (dHxd_y - dHyd_x) / (1j * beta + 1e-15)\n\n    return Hz\n\n\ndef _reconstruct_e(\n    Hx: np.ndarray,\n    Hy: np.ndarray,\n    Hz: np.ndarray,\n    x: np.ndarray,\n    y: np.ndarray,\n    beta: complex,\n    omega: float,\n    epsilon: EpsilonCallback,\n) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:\n    \"\"\"Reconstruct electric field components Ex, Ey, Ez from H fields.\n\n    Uses:\n        D = (1/(j*omega)) * curl H\n        E = inv(eps) * D\n    \"\"\"\n    ny, nx = Hx.shape\n    diffx = np.diff(x)\n    diffy = np.diff(y)\n\n    Ex = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n    Ey = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n    Ez = np.zeros((ny - 1, nx - 1), dtype=np.complex128)\n\n    for j in range(ny - 1):\n        for i in range(nx - 1):\n            dx = diffx[i] if i < len(diffx) else diffx[-1] if len(diffx) > 0 else 1.0\n            dy = diffy[j] if j < len(diffy) else diffy[-1] if len(diffy) > 0 else 1.0\n            xc = (x[j] + x[j + 1]) / 2.0 if j < len(x) - 1 else x[j]\n            yc = (y[i] + y[i + 1]) / 2.0 if i < len(y) - 1 else y[i]\n\n            eps_xx, eps_xy, eps_yx, eps_yy, eps_zz = epsilon(xc, yc)\n            det_eps = eps_xx * eps_yy - eps_xy * eps_yx + 1e-15\n\n            # dHz/dy\n            dHz_dy = (Hz[j, i] + Hz[j + 1, i] - Hz[j, i + 1] - Hz[j + 1, i + 1]) / (2.0 * dy) if j < Hz.shape[0] and i < Hz.shape[1] else 0.0\n            # dHz/dx\n            dHz_dx = (Hz[j + 1, i + 1] + Hz[j + 1, i] - Hz[j, i + 1] - Hz[j, i]) / (2.0 * dx) if j < Hz.shape[0] and i < Hz.shape[1] else 0.0\n\n            # D components (with beta correction for propagation)\n            Dx = dHz_dy / (1j * omega + 1e-15) + beta / omega * (Hy[j + 1, i + 1] + Hy[j + 1, i] + Hy[j, i + 1] + Hy[j, i]) / 4.0\n            Dy = -dHz_dx / (1j * omega + 1e-15) - beta / omega * (Hx[j + 1, i + 1] + Hx[j + 1, i] + Hx[j, i + 1] + Hx[j, i]) / 4.0\n\n            Ex[j, i] = (eps_yy * Dx - eps_yx * Dy) / det_eps\n            Ey[j, i] = (-eps_xy * Dx + eps_xx * Dy) / det_eps\n            Ez[j, i] = 0.0  # Simplified: would need dHy/dx - dHx/dy\n\n    return Ex, Ey, Ez\n\n\ndef solve_modes(\n    config: ModeSolverConfig,\n    epsilon: EpsilonCallback,\n    x: tuple[float, ...],\n    y: tuple[float, ...],\n) -> tuple[ModeSolution, ...]:\n    \"\"\"Solve for waveguide modes on a cross-sectional grid.\n\n    Args:\n        config: Mode solver configuration\n        epsilon: Callback returning permittivity tensor at (x, y)\n        x: Cell-center x coordinates\n        y: Cell-center y coordinates\n\n    Returns:\n        Tuple of ModeSolution objects sorted by neff descending\n    \"\"\"\n    if eigs is None:\n        raise ModuleNotFoundError(\"scipy is required for the mode solver\")\n\n    nx = len(x)\n    ny = len(y)\n    N = nx * ny\n\n    # Assemble sparse matrix\n    A = assemble_mode_matrix(x, y, config.wavelength, epsilon, config.cross_section.boundaries)\n\n    # Target number of eigenvalues\n    nev = min(config.mode_spec.num_modes, N)\n\n    # Eigensolver sigma: target neff or None for largest real part\n    sigma = None\n    if config.mode_spec.target_neff is not None:\n        k = 2.0 * math.pi / config.wavelength\n        sigma = config.mode_spec.target_neff**2 * k**2  # β² = neff² * k²\n\n    # Solve\n    beta_sq, phi = eigs(\n        A,\n        k=nev,\n        sigma=sigma,\n = eigs(\n            A,\n            k=nev,\n            sigma=sigma,\n            tol=config.tolerance,\n            which=\"LM\" if sigma is not None else \"LR\",\n            maxiter=2000,\n        )\n    except Exception as exc:\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"eigensolver failed: {exc}\") from exc\n\n    # Sort by |β²| descending (largest propagation constant first)\n    sorted_indices = sorted(range(len(beta_sq)), key=lambda i: -abs(beta_sq[i].real))\n\n    modes: list[ModeSolution] = []\n    for idx in sorted_indices:\n        beta_sq_val = beta_sq[idx]\n\n        # β² should be real for lossless/weakly-lossy guides\n        beta_sq_real = beta_sq_val.real\n        if beta_sq_real <= 0:\n            # Skip non-propagating (evanescent) modes\n            continue\n\n        beta = math.sqrt(beta_sq_real)\n        neff = beta / k if k > 0 else 0.0\n\n        # Extract Hx, Hy\n        Hx_flat = phi[:N, idx]\n        Hy_flat = phi[N : 2 * N, idx]\n\n        Hx = Hx_flat.reshape((ny, nx))\n        Hy = Hy_flat.reshape((ny, nx))\n\n        # Reconstruct Hz\n        Hz = _reconstruct_hz(Hx, Hy, np.asarray(x), np.asarray(y), beta)\n\n        # Reconstruct E fields\n        Ex, Ey, Ez = _reconstruct_fields(Hx, Hy, Hz, np.asarray(x), np.asarray(y), beta, omega, epsilon)\n\n        # Compute power (integral of |E|²)\n        power = float(\n            np.sum(np.abs(Ex) ** 2) + np.sum(np.abs(Ey) ** 2) + np.sum(np.abs(Ez) ** 2)\n        )\n        power_norm = 1.0 / math.sqrt(power) if power > 1e-15 else 1.0\n\n        def _to_tuple_complex(arr: np.ndarray) -> tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]:\n            flat = arr.flatten()\n            return tuple((float(v.real), float(v.imag)) for v in flat)\n\n        # Downsample Hx, Hy to cell centers to match E\n        Hx_c = (Hx[:-1, :-1] + Hx[1:, :-1] + Hx[:-1, 1:] + Hx[1:, 1:]) / 4.0\n        Hy_c = (Hy[:-1, :-1] + Hy[1:, :-1] + Hy[:-1, 1:] + Hy[1:, 1:]) / 4.0\n        Hz_c = Hz\n\n        modes.append(\n            ModeSolution(\n                neff=neff,\n                wavelength=config.wavelength,\n                x=x,\n                y=y,\n                Ex=_to_tuple_complex(Ex * power_norm),\n                Ey=_to_tuple_complex(Ey * power_norm),\n                Ez=_to_tuple_complex(Ez * power_norm),\n                Hx=_to_tuple_complex(Hx_c * power_norm),\n                Hy=_to_tuple_complex(Hy_c * power_norm),\n                Hz=_to_tuple_complex(Hz_c * power_norm),\n                power=power * power_norm**2,\n            )\n        )\n\n        if len(modes) >= config.mode_spec.num_modes:\n            break\n\n    return tuple(modes)\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"EpsilonCallback\",\n    \"assemble_mode_matrix\",\n    \"solve_modes\",\n]\n"}}

material-aware CFL relaxation and richer convergence heuristics remain deferred.\n- Keep runtime logging separate from benchmark metrics: Phase 1 emits deterministic progress records at step 0, configurable progress intervals, and final stop, while every shutoff check still lands in convergence evidence even when progress logging is downsampled.\n- Keep Phase 1 source-time scope narrow and explicit: implement `GaussianPulse` and `ContinuousWave` as standalone immutable models first, preserve Tidy3D-style `freq0`/`fwidth`/`offset` semantics plus `remove_dc_component` on Gaussian pulses, and defer broader source-time families to their own tasks instead of hiding them behind loose dict payloads.\n- Phase 1 `BroadbandPulse` is a clearly delimited analytic subset: represent it as a Gaussian-modulated carrier derived from `(freq_range, minimum_amplitude)` rather than trying to reproduce Tidy3D's licensed extension internals, and keep `CustomSourceTime` as explicit sample interpolation with nearest-value clamping outside the provided range.\n- Phase 1 `UniformCurrentSource` uses primal-cell placement metadata rather than hidden source snapping: zero-size axes interpolate between neighboring cell centers when enabled, finite extents either select center-in-bounds cells or overlap-fraction weights when `confine_to_bounds=True`, and `\"total\"` amplitude normalization divides by the local transverse extent implied by the source geometry and resolved grid.\n\n## Task Handoffs\n\n- `task-003` should add versioned IR models under `autofdtd.ir` without coupling them to the public API module layout; runtime/compiler code can treat arrays as pre-expanded ordered geometry.\n- Phase 1 `PolySlab` scope is intentionally limited to constant-cross-section extrusions of simple polygons on principal axes; deliberately narrow: derive a vacuum baseline from wavelength and domain size, discretize piecewise with a simple `max_scale` grading pass, and limit refinement inputs to `LayerRefinementSpec` body and bound hints rather than full geometry-driven meshing.\n- Keep Phase 1 subpixel support narrow and explicit: dielectric interfaces may use `PolarizedAveraging` or `Staircasing`, while metal, PEC, runtime helpers instead of pretending they are extremely lossy ordinary media.\n- Phase 1 `PoleResidue` keeps complex numbers JSON-safe as `(real, imag)` tuples in the public API and IR so serialization stays stable without inventing ad hoc string encoding.\n- Phase 1 PoleResidue runtime support is electric-only and uses one complex polarization accumulator per pole; magnetic dispersion remains out of scope until later material families require it.\n- Phase 1 `Sellmeier` support is intentionally passive-only and homogeneous-only: `B_i >= 0`, `C_i >= 0`, zero-`C_i` terms fold into `eps_inf`, and all timestep execution reuses the existing electric-only `PoleResidueMaterialCoefficients` path instead of creating a new auxiliary-state layout.\n- Phase 1 `Lorentz` is passive-only (`delta_eps >= 0`, `damping >= 0`, `frequency^2 != damping^2`), `Drude` is limited to damped poles (`damping > 0`) so it can lower cleanly onto the current pole-residue path, and `Debye` is passive-only (`delta_eps >= 0`, `tau > 0`).\n- The current exact-hold pole-residue recurrence path can overflow for sufficiently stiff poles relative to `dt`; material compilation now raises an explicit error instead of emitting unusable coefficients, which is especially relevant for very small-`tau` Debye fits.\n- Phase 1 anisotropy stops at diagonal tensor media: `AnisotropicMedium` is implemented and IR-lowered, `FullyAnisotropicMedium` remains an explicit deferred error for runtime compilation, and `Medium2D` remains a deferred direct-simulation feature with offline conversion helpers only.\n- Advanced material policy is explicit rather than silent: `LossyMetalMedium` and perturbation media are parseable defer buckets with manual fallback helpers, while sampled `Custom*` special-casing them inside the future timestep loop: PEC uses odd tangential electric and odd normal magnetic parity, while PMC uses the opposite parity assignment.\n- Keep Phase 1 PML deliberately narrow: use Tidy3D-shaped `num_layers + parameters + extrude_structures` public models, compile one profile per boundary face, and treat the first runnable backend as a staged damping layer with persistent face memory rather than a full split-field CPML implementation.\n- Keep `StablePML` as a preset-driven extension of the baseline staged PML backend in Phase 1 rather than a separate field-splitting formulation; runtime differentiation is through compiled profile metadata and defaults, not a distinct kernel family.\n- Keep `Absorber` practical and explicit: Phase 1 uses a conductivity-ramp absorbing subset with no auxiliary memory contribution and a PEC-like outer-wall reflection policy, trading fidelity for a clear stable fallback when baseline PML is unsuitable.\n- Keep `ABCBoundary` practical and narrow: Phase 1 implements only the explicit-parameter first-order subset, and automatic medium inference plus mode-based ABC stay deferred until scene-material sampling and mode-solver tasks are available.\n- Keep runtime convergence explicit and narrow: Phase 1 shutoff is the Tidy3D-style ratio of instantaneous integrated electric-field intensity to its historical maximum, checked on a configurable step interval; material-aware CFL relaxation and richer convergence heuristics remain deferred.\n- Keep runtime logging separate from benchmark metrics: Phase 1 emits deterministic progress records at step 0, configurable progress intervals, and final stop, while every shutoff check still lands in convergence evidence even when progress logging is downsampled.\n- Keep Phase 1 source-time scope narrow and explicit: implement `GaussianPulse` and `ContinuousWave` as standalone immutable models first, preserve Tidy3D-style `freq0`/`fwidth`/`offset` semantics plus `remove_dc_component` on Gaussian pulses, and defer broader source-time families to their own tasks instead of hiding them behind loose dict payloads.\n- Phase 1 `BroadbandPulse` is a clearly delimited analytic subset: represent it as a Gaussian-modulated carrier derived from `(freq_range, minimum_amplitude)` rather than trying to reproduce Tidy3D's licensed extension internals, and keep `CustomSourceTime` as explicit sample interpolation with nearest-value clamping outside the provided range.\n- Phase 1 `UniformCurrentSource` uses primal-cell placement metadata rather than hidden source snapping: zero-size axes interpolate between neighboring cell centers when enabled, finite extents either select center-in-bounds cells or overlap-fraction weights when `confine_to_bounds=True`, and `\"total\"` amplitude normalization divides by the local transverse extent implied by the source geometry and resolved grid.\n\n## Task Handoffs\n\n- `task-003` should
